provenance: Codex subagent review of immutable prepared inputs; findings checked against source, separate from deterministic validation.
rationale: AuditInventory creates candidates for forward/local/unordered internal occurrences. validate_review requires necessity, signposting with a real source span, and minimal-use rationale for exceptions; cross_validate compares current coverage roles and target-definition positions, rejecting false backward or navigation dispositions and disagreement. Tests exercise these cases and freshness after source/order movement. The prose distinguishes a justified review from a detected candidate or cycle and accurately describes all three required reasons.
limitations: This is a source-level comparison of the retained authored unit, exact cited declarations/tests and policy. It is not proof of exhaustive implementation behavior, a browser rendering test or a claim that every conservative context file was read. The reviewer authored the new audit integration/tests, then performed this separate comparison pass; no independence from that implementation is claimed.
